title: CONFIDENCE HAS AN ARCHITECTURE
passages: Runway appealed to the maker in me. Tiny adjustments changed the whole experience: the shoulders, the timing, the tension, the release. Presence could be practiced with the same attention I brought to other kinds of design.

The shows also revealed how much happened before the walk. Training, stretching, self-doubt, mirrors, and repetition. Backstage, artists worked with fabric, makeup, accessories, and encouragement. The finished moment belonged to a whole room of people. I loved being part of that room.

reflections.prompt: What small adjustment could change how you show up?
Pick one thing you are learning. Name a tiny adjustment you could practice, and someone whose help you appreciate.
Practice the tiny adjustment once. Describe the difference in plain words.
